### Checklist

- [ ] Source-backed names, descriptions and inputSchema copied/versioned
- [ ] Permissions, prices, data transfer and side effects classified
- [ ] RU/EN/square-brand identity consistency checked
- [ ] Direct/indirect/negative golden prompts prepared
- [ ] Full-shell usage and actual call separated
- [ ] One-field improvement hypothesis preregistered
- [ ] Safe A/B replay completed OR exact blocker recorded
- [ ] Proposed minimal change assigned to receiving product owner
- [ ] Post-deploy verification linked (if deployed)

**Status:** UNTESTED / EVIDENCED / HANDOFF / VERIFIED / BLOCKED.
